title: Bram and the Songbook
author: Silas Pemberton
blurb: Mara Nakamura, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
